products.title: Solar Proposal Decoder
products.author: Casey Rowan
products.status_note: KDP-ready 57-page PDF interior (58 pages after KDP rounding); content, layout, QA and commercial package frozen. Awaiting human cover selection, live KDP template, upload and Print Previewer.
production_learnings: A decoder-first reference can carry paid value while the write-in packet remains an execution layer.
One three-proposal packet was sufficient; duplicating blank packets would have padded the product.
The write-in matrices make Kindle technically supported but commercially unjustified.
Large-trim black-ink economics are favorable below the 110-page fixed-cost threshold.

evidence.summary: Full decoder-first manuscript, paperback production master, write-in packet, source/claim/volatility ledgers, visual QA sheets and final commercial package completed.
Exact Amazon query showed no direct homeowner proposal-comparison workbook; adjacent 2026 homeowner solar books showed visible current activity.

decisions.reason: The approved paid-value mechanism survives full production; all internal content, factual, editorial, product-quality, format, technical and commercial gates pass. External cover and KDP preview remain human-controlled.
